Metadata.title: LiveDocs — Write together, in real time
Metadata.description: LiveDocs is a real-time collaborative document editor. Write, comment, and share with your team the moment ideas happen — no refresh, no version conflicts.
Metadata.ogAlt: LiveDocs product dashboard showing a shared document with live collaborator cursors

hero.subtitle: LiveDocs is a real-time document editor. See every cursor as it moves, leave comments right where the idea is, and decide exactly who can edit or only read.

mock.p1a: We're shipping the new onboarding in October. The goal is simple: a new teammate should
mock.hl: write their first doc in under two minutes
mock.p2: Open questions: the pricing copy, the empty state, and who owns the migration checklist.

threads.name: Sari
threads.text: Two minutes feels tight. Can we test it with five new hires first?

threads.name: Budi
threads.text: @Sari agreed, I'll set up the test this week.

threads.name: Anya
threads.text: Typo in the intro is fixed.

trust.kicker: Built on tools engineers already trust

dashboard.title: Every document, one calm dashboard
dashboard.body: Search, filter and sort everything you own or were invited to, then jump back into the live room with one click.

access.title: Every role, every language, every mood
access.body: Invite people as editors or viewers, switch between English and Bahasa Indonesia, and pick light or dark. Try the controls in the frame below, they really work.

comments.body: Select any text, start a thread, mention a teammate. Replies, resolves and notifications all happen without leaving the page.

big.leftTitle: Never ask “is this the latest version?” again
big.leftBody: There's only one version: the one everyone is editing right now. Changes sync as they happen, so nothing gets emailed, renamed “final_v3”, or overwritten.

items.title: Live cursors & presence
items.body: See who's in the document and exactly where they're typing, so you never overwrite each other.

items.title: Threaded comments
items.body: Start a conversation on any selection, reply in a thread, and resolve it when it's done.

items.title: Editor or viewer, per person
items.body: Invite by email, choose what each person can do, and change it or revoke it any time.

items.title: Mentions and an inbox
items.body: @mention a teammate and it lands in their notifications, together with new shares.

items.title: Two languages, two themes
items.body: The whole app speaks English and Bahasa Indonesia, in light or dark, your choice.

items.title: Private by default
items.body: New documents are visible only to you. Sign-in runs on Auth.js and access is checked per document.

useCases.title: Made for how people actually write

items.label: For product & engineering teams
items.statement: Write the spec once. Everyone reads the same version.

items.label: For students & study groups
items.statement: Split up the report, not the group chat.

items.label: For freelancers & agencies
items.statement: Share a draft with a client, read-only, and take it back whenever you want.

steps.title: Up and writing in three steps

items.title: Create your account
items.body: Sign up in a few seconds. No install, no credit card.

items.title: Start a document
items.body: Hit New Document. It opens as a live room that only you can see.

items.title: Invite your team
items.body: Add teammates by email as editors or viewers. They get a notification right away.

rows.title: You decide who's in
rows.body: Invite by email as an editor or a viewer, change roles at any time, and remove access with one click.

rows.title: Private by default
rows.body: A new document is visible only to you. Sign-in runs on Auth.js and real-time sync runs on Liveblocks.

footer.tagline: Real-time documents for teams that think out loud.
footer.credits: Paintings are in the public domain, via Wikimedia Commons. Photos from Pexels.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.description: How LiveDocs collects, uses, and protects your data.

sections.heading: What this policy covers
body: LiveDocs is a real-time collaborative document editor. This policy explains what personal data we process when you use it, why, and what choices you have.

sections.heading: Data we process
body: Account data: your name, email address, and a hashed password (we never store your password in plain text).
Content you create: documents, comments, and the list of email addresses you share them with.
Technical data: IP address and request metadata used for security (rate limiting, abuse prevention) and error reports used to fix bugs.

sections.heading: Why we use it
body: To provide the service: sign you in, sync documents in real time, and deliver invitations and notifications.
To keep the service safe: limit repeated login attempts and detect abuse.
To send transactional emails only: email verification, password reset, and security notices. We do not send marketing email.

sections.heading: Service providers
body: We use trusted providers to run LiveDocs: Liveblocks (real-time collaboration and document storage), MongoDB (account database), an email delivery provider (transactional email), Sentry (error monitoring, configured without personal data by default), and our hosting provider. They process data on our behalf and only for these purposes.

sections.heading: Cookies
body: We use only strictly necessary cookies and storage: a session cookie that keeps you signed in, and your theme and language preferences. We do not use advertising or cross-site tracking cookies.

sections.heading: Retention and deletion
body: We keep your account and documents until you ask us to delete them. Unverified sign-ups expire after 24 hours and password reset links after 1 hour.

sections.heading: Your rights
body: You can ask to access, correct, export, or delete your personal data at any time. Depending on where you live, you may also have the right to object to or restrict certain processing.

sections.heading: Security
body: We protect your data with encryption in transit (HTTPS), modern password hashing (Argon2id), access controls on every document, and rate limiting. No system is perfectly secure, so please use a strong, unique password.

sections.heading: Changes
body: We may update this policy. When we make material changes we will update the date above.

sections.heading: Acceptance
body: By creating an account or using LiveDocs you agree to these terms. If you don't agree, please don't use the service.

sections.heading: Your account
body: Provide accurate information, verify your email, and keep your password secret. You are responsible for activity under your account. Tell us promptly if you suspect unauthorized access.

sections.heading: Your content
body: You own the documents and comments you create. You give us permission to host, process, and display them only as needed to run the service. You decide who can view or edit each document; you are responsible for the people you share it with.

sections.heading: Acceptable use
body: Do not use LiveDocs to break the law, infringe others' rights, distribute malware, or harass others. Do not attempt to bypass security or rate limits, probe other users' accounts, or disrupt the service.

sections.heading: Availability
body: We work to keep LiveDocs available and your data safe, but the service is provided "as is" without guarantees of uninterrupted operation. Keep your own backups of important documents.

sections.heading: Termination
body: You can stop using LiveDocs and ask us to delete your account at any time. We may suspend accounts that violate these terms.

sections.heading: Limitation of liability
body: To the maximum extent permitted by law, LiveDocs is not liable for indirect or consequential losses arising from your use of the service.

sections.heading: Changes
body: We may update these terms. Continuing to use LiveDocs after an update means you accept the new terms.
